svg.aria-label: Left: depth–disparity relation for focal length 800 pixels and baseline 0.12 meters; 3 meters corresponds to 32 pixels. Right: actual sphere and cube test clouds with 64 points, colored by normalized z. Coordinates are centered and scaled by maximum point distance.
